styles.css: body{-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}.wp-site-blocks{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100vh}.wp-site-blocks>main{flex:1 0 auto}.alab-barra{border-bottom:1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--linha);background:var(--wp--preset--color--fundo-profundo)}.alab-barra-inner,.alab-rodape-inner{box-sizing:border-box;max-width:1320px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px a:hover{color:var(--wp--preset--color--prata-100)}.alab-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:12px
